subject: general
question: When touching a hot object with the hand, human beings are able to remove their hand immediately because:

options.text: every living organism can do so
human beings are more intelligent than others
human beings are sensitive to the stimulus of touch
human beings are the supreme creatures of the living world

solution:
The correct answer is __**human beings are sensitive to the stimulus of touch**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Human beings are sensitive to the stimulus of touch:** When a person touches a hot object, the sensory neurons present in the skin detect the intense heat. This triggers a reflex action, enabling the individual to withdraw their hand immediately. This sensitivity is due to the complex nervous system and is a fundamental survival mechanism.
 
• **Reflex action:** The process of withdrawing the hand occurs through a reflex arc, which is an automatic and quick response to a harmful stimulus. The message is carried by sensory neurons to the spinal cord, which sends a direct signal to motor neurons to remove the hand without involving the brain immediately.
 
• **Role of the nervous system:** The nervous system, particularly the peripheral nervous system, plays a critical role in detecting stimuli such as heat, cold, or pain and initiating an appropriate response. The skin contains specialized nerve endings that are highly sensitive to such stimuli.
